assets.credit: NASA / JPL-Caltech / SSI / Southwest Research Institute / Malin Space Science Systems / Italian Space Agency (ASI) / Italian National Institute for Astrophysics (INAF) / JIRAM / Björn Jónsson
assets.preparation: Downsampled using Lanczos to 8192x4096 (and 4096x2048); JPEG quality 95/94 with 4:4:4 chroma. No color changes or invented detail.
assets.projection: Equirectangular; north at top. Approximate image-coordinate Great Red Spot center x=0.854, y=0.627 from top.
assets.limitations: Historical Cassini equatorial mosaic combined with Juno polar observations, not one epoch or live atmospheric data. Colors pale cream/ochre; poles gray-blue. Original is 95MB; serve the optimized JPEG only.

assets.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Björn Jónsson; improved and recolored by Askaniy Anpilogov (2019)
assets.projection: Simple cylindrical/equirectangular; north at top. Source original map uses planetographic latitude; render on oblate spheroid, equatorial radius 60268 km / polar 54362 km.
assets.limitations: Historical Cassini southern hemisphere and Voyager northern hemisphere mosaic, improved/recolored by Celestia contributor. Not current atmospheric observations. Very subtle natural gold banding; avoid artificial high-contrast stripes.

assets.credit: Solar System Scope / INOVE; based on NASA imagery
assets.preparation: Central row y=250 extracted from 8192x500 RGBA source as 8192x1 radial sampler. Color and alpha unchanged.
assets.projection: Horizontal coordinate runs radially inner to outer. Sample y=0.5. Alpha is opacity.
assets.limitations: Provider supplies texture without published physical radius calibration on download page; do not claim scientific optical-depth precision. Includes slightly saturated color, source-map adjustments and filled gaps. Rendering needs planet shadow on rings, ring shadow on globe, and separate unlit-side response.

assets.credit: NASA, ESA, A. Simon (Goddard Space Flight Center), and M.H. Wong (University of California, Berkeley)
assets.preparation: Unmodified JPEG returned by NASA dynamic image service at full source width 3600.
assets.projection: Global flat map; north at top. Polar regions above 80 degrees are excluded (black).
assets.limitations: Observed in 2019, not current. Lower resolution than selected Cassini/Juno map; polar coverage incomplete. Included as primary NASA research reference.
